title: A Giraffe's Blood Pressure Is Double Yours. Why It Doesn't Faint

scenes.text: A giraffe's blood pressure would hospitalize you.
It's about twice as high as ours, and its heart weighs up to 26 pounds.
Because the brain sits way up there, and the heart has to push blood all the way to it.
Now lower that head to drink, and pressure in the head roughly doubles again.
But special vessels in the head and tight skin on the legs keep it from fainting.
So the pressure that would hurt you is the giraffe's survival tool.
